verdict.rationale: Lago documents a first-party 'Lago Agent SDK' that wraps an existing LLM client, so there is an official SDK, but its scope appears limited to agent and LLM metering. Nothing in the evidence documents official general-purpose language SDKs for the billing API; the OpenAPI 3.1 schema for generating clients is a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented official language SDKs (e.g. Python/Node/Ruby/Go) covering the full API, SDK reference docs and install instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
